# Soak USA — LLM-Friendly Site Summary

> Soak USA is an authority-first hot-spring research and safety publication. It is not a live-conditions, emergency, land-management, or medical service.

## Current Status

- Domain: soakusa.net
- Public location records: 0
- The legacy location catalog was withdrawn after a data-quality audit found material geography and feature-classification errors.
- Retired browse, state, and location URLs return a 404 response with catalog-reset guidance.
- A future record requires a visible authoritative source, publisher, title, review date, supported-claim mapping, and human review.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://soakusa.net): Current catalog status and official safety sources
- [Editorial Standards](https://soakusa.net/editorial): Publication, classification, sourcing, and correction requirements
- [About](https://soakusa.net/about): Mission, catalog reset, safety boundaries, and accountability
- [Disclosure](https://soakusa.net/disclosure): Current advertising and affiliated-shop status
- [Contact](https://soakusa.net/contact): Corrections and source submissions
- [Privacy](https://soakusa.net/privacy): Current privacy and tracking practices
- [Terms](https://soakusa.net/terms): Site terms and safety boundaries

## Safety Boundary

Managed hot tubs and uncontrolled natural thermal areas are not interchangeable. Readers must use the responsible authority for current permission, closures, access, hazards, and emergency information. Soak USA does not provide medical advice.
